split_method: Manual stratification by source collection and question type; 15 Dev and 5 Test questions selected from 20 distinct source articles before retrieval.
test_access_policy: Do not inspect retrieval results for Test until the model bake-off (if used) and A/B/C evaluation on Dev are complete and the chosen model and strategy are frozen.
model_selection_rule: Compare model candidates only on Strategy B chunks and the 15 Dev questions.
Maximize Dev Evidence Hit@3 using the official full-evidence definition.
If tied, prefer higher Hit@1; if still tied, prefer lower measured latency and operational cost.
Freeze exactly one model for the official A/B/C experiment before Test.
strategy_selection_rule: Maximize Dev Evidence Hit@3 using the official full-evidence definition.
If tied, prefer higher mean manual coherence on the ten preselected source positions.
If still tied, prefer lower measured ingestion time, chunk count and operational complexity.
filter_policy: Apply a collection filter only when the question explicitly supplies the programming-language or computer-science scope; never derive it from gold metadata.
